stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Nathaniel Malick finds Kora, trains her to control her powers, and fills her head with talk of meeting her sister Daisy. The two grow close and share a kiss after she helps the Chronicoms break into the Lighthouse.
stages.whoA: Nathaniel Malick. He trains her powers and draws her into his plans.
stages.whoB: Kora, Daisy's lost sister. He trains her and keeps her close.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Kora learns that Nathaniel killed her mother, Jiaying, and turns on him. She fights at Daisy's side to stop him.
stages.whoA: Nathaniel. He killed her mother, and she turns on him.
stages.whoB: Kora. She learns he killed Jiaying and fights him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Sibyl foresees Kora's path and tells her all about Daisy. Kora goes along with the Chronicom predictor's plans while she serves Nathaniel.
stages.whoA: Sibyl, the Chronicom who foresaw her and told her about Daisy.
stages.whoB: Kora, an Inhuman who serves her plans.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: When Kora breaks with Nathaniel, she sides with S.H.I.E.L.D. against Sibyl and the Chronicoms.
stages.whoA: Sibyl. Now an enemy she fights beside Daisy.
stages.whoB: Kora. She turns against the Chronicoms.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Nathaniel works with Sibyl and the Chronicoms against S.H.I.E.L.D. He chafes when she orders him to be patient and leave Quake to her Hunters.
stages.whoA: Sibyl, the Chronicom leader he works with.
stages.whoB: Nathaniel Malick, a HYDRA ally she keeps on a short leash.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Freddy Malick is Nathaniel's father, a HYDRA man his son scorns for being bound by its rules. In 1976, when S.H.I.E.L.D. takes Nathaniel hostage, Freddy lets Coulson and May go to get his son back.
stages.whoA: His father, a HYDRA man he looks down on.
stages.whoB: His younger son, Nathaniel.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: In 1931, Sibyl's Chronicom Hunters try to kill Freddy, and S.H.I.E.L.D. saves him.
stages.whoA: Sibyl. Her Chronicom Hunters try to kill him.
stages.whoB: Freddy Malick, a target in 1931.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: By 1976, Freddy is working with Sibyl's Chronicoms, who help him rush Project Insight.
stages.whoA: Sibyl, whose Chronicoms help him rush Project Insight.
stages.whoB: Freddy Malick, now working for her plan.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Sarge hunts Izel across worlds, sure that she killed his family. In truth he is Pachakutiq, who once loved her, and she shoots him to wake his true self.
stages.whoA: Sarge, who hunts her. Truly Pachakutiq, her old love.
stages.whoB: Izel, the alien he hunts, once the one he loved.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Posing as Mack, Izel gets Professor Benson to share his research on her people. She then reveals herself and forces him to lead her to the Temple of the Forgotten.
stages.whoA: Professor Benson, a scholar she forces to find her temple.
stages.whoB: Izel, who wears Mack's body and forces him to help.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Benson and Agent Keller work together at S.H.I.E.L.D. on the case of the alien Shrike, studying the bodies it leaves behind.
stages.whoA: Agent Keller, a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague on the Shrike case.
stages.whoB: Professor Benson, who studies the Shrike with him.

stages.title: Team Thor, Team Thor: Part 2 & Team Darryl
stages.text: Thor moves in with Darryl, an office worker in Australia, while the other Avengers fight over the Accords. Darryl helps him send emails and gets stuck with most of the cleaning, and Thor makes him the other half of Team Thor.
stages.whoA: Thor, his flatmate, who makes him half of Team Thor.
stages.whoB: Darryl, his Australian flatmate and teammate.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peggy takes the serum in Steve's place after he is shot, and he fights beside her in the Hydra Stomper armor. They fall for each other and set a date for a dance, but she is pulled through the Tesseract's portal and lost to him.
stages.whoA: Steve, the man she loves. They never get their dance.
stages.whoB: Peggy, the woman he loves, lost through the portal.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Seventy years later, Peggy learns the Red Room has kept a brainwashed Steve inside the Stomper. She reaches him, but he flies the armor into the Red Room's base and is lost in the blast.
stages.whoA: Steve, found alive and brainwashed, then lost again.
stages.whoB: Peggy. She breaks through to him before he sacrifices himself.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Hydra Stomper attacks Peggy and Natasha, and Peggy finds Steve inside, brainwashed by the Red Room. Telling him she only wants to be with him, she breaks his conditioning before he flies the armor into the Red Room's base.
stages.whoA: Steve, the man she loves, trapped in the Red Room's armor.
stages.whoB: Peggy, the woman he loves, who breaks his brainwashing.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peggy leads the Allied fight against HYDRA and its leader, Johann Schmidt. At Castle de Krake, Red Skull taunts her as he summons a monster through the Tesseract, and it kills him.
stages.whoA: Red Skull, HYDRA's leader and her enemy in the war.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, the super soldier leading the Allies against him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kruger bombs Project Rebirth, killing Erskine, and tries to escape with the serum. Peggy kills him and saves the vial, which she then takes herself.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA spy she kills at Project Rebirth.
stages.whoB: Peggy Carter, who kills him and recovers the serum.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The frail Steve tries to stop Kruger's escape from Project Rebirth, and Kruger shoots him. The wound keeps Steve from taking the serum.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA spy who shoots him before he can take the serum.
stages.whoB: Steve Rogers, the recruit he shoots.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Steve takes the Hydra Stomper into battle against Red Skull's HYDRA. On a raid to capture Red Skull, a train packed with explosives blows up under him, and he is later found inside Red Skull's castle.
stages.whoA: Red Skull, the HYDRA leader he fights in the Stomper.
stages.whoB: Steve Rogers, the pilot of the Hydra Stomper.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: In the present, Natasha becomes Peggy's close friend and partner on S.H.I.E.L.D. missions. Together they find the Hydra Stomper armor hidden on Batroc's ship.
stages.whoA: Natasha, her closest friend and partner on missions.
stages.whoB: Peggy, her close friend and fellow Avenger.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Natasha kept what she knew about the Red Room and Steve from Peggy to spare her heart, but she helps her free him anyway. When Peggy sets out to find him again, Natasha goes with her.
stages.whoA: Natasha, who helps her save Steve and follows her anywhere.
stages.whoB: Peggy, the friend she follows even when she disagrees.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Hydra Stomper attacks Natasha and Peggy on the Lemurian Star, then strikes again at the Triskelion.
stages.whoA: The Red Room's war machine, which attacks her and Peggy.
stages.whoB: Natasha, Peggy's partner and one of its targets.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Natasha distrusts Steve once he wakes, but helps Peggy save him. As he flies off to destroy the Red Room, she ties Melina to his armor.
stages.whoA: Steve Rogers, freed with her help, though she distrusts him.
stages.whoB: Natasha, Peggy's friend, who helps free him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Melina controls the brainwashed Steve and sends him in the Hydra Stomper to bring her Captain Carter. Once free, Steve flies the armor into the Red Room's base, killing her.
stages.whoA: Steve Rogers, the brainwashed weapon she controls.
stages.whoB: Melina, the Red Room leader who controls him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Melina stages the Hydra Stomper's attacks to lure Peggy away from the Avengers and S.H.I.E.L.D. She springs her trap at an old Sokovian base, but loses Steve and dies with the Red Room.
stages.whoA: Captain Carter, the prize she lures into her trap.
stages.whoB: Melina, the Red Room leader who sets a trap for her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Natasha has already killed the head of the Red Room, and Melina's Widows hunt her through a Sokovian town. Melina nearly chokes her, but Natasha ties her to the Stomper's cable and drags her to her death.
stages.whoA: Natasha, the Widow who ties her to the doomed armor.
stages.whoB: Melina, the Red Room leader who nearly kills her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Yondu's men take young T'Challa from Wakanda by mistake, and Yondu raises him as a Ravager and as his son. T'Challa grows up to be the famous Star-Lord at his side.
stages.whoA: His adopted son, the famous Star-Lord.
stages.whoB: The Ravager captain who raised him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Challa learns Yondu lied that Wakanda was destroyed and says he was never family. They make peace after beating the Collector together, and Yondu urges him to go home to his parents.
stages.whoA: His son, who forgives him for his lie.
stages.whoB: The father figure who lied about Wakanda, now forgiven.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Nebula brings T'Challa's Ravagers the job of stealing the Embers of Genesis. She seems to sell him out to the Collector, but it is a triple cross, and she frees the crew.
stages.whoA: Nebula, a thief who brings him the Embers job.
stages.whoB: T'Challa, the Star-Lord she brings a job and then saves.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Challa talks Thanos out of wiping out half the universe, and the reformed Titan joins his Ravagers. Thanos rides with the crew on the raid of the Collector.
stages.whoA: Thanos, a Titan he talked out of his plan. Now a crewmate.
stages.whoB: Star-Lord, who talked him out of his plan.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Thanos is Nebula's father, and both run with the Ravagers. When the Black Order overpowers him on Knowhere, Nebula comes back to save him.
stages.whoA: Her father, a reformed Titan.
stages.whoB: His daughter, who saves him on Knowhere.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Carina, the Collector's servant, is moved by T'Challa's words against keeping beings caged. She kills Ebony Maw to free him and then releases every creature in the collection.
stages.whoA: Carina, the Collector's servant who saves him.
stages.whoB: Star-Lord, whose words inspire her to rebel.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Challa breaks into the Collector's vault for the Embers of Genesis and is nearly put on display. He and Yondu beat the Collector and lock him in one of his own cases.
stages.whoA: The Collector, who tries to put him on display.
stages.whoB: Star-Lord, the outlaw who robs and cages him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Yondu fears the Collector and only takes the job for T'Challa's sake. The Collector breaks his Yaka Arrow, but Yondu helps trap him in his own exhibit.
stages.whoA: The Collector, the warlord he fears and helps to cage.
stages.whoB: Yondu, a Ravager who helps cage him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Carina serves the Collector on Knowhere, tending the beings he keeps.
stages.whoA: Her master, the Collector.
stages.whoB: Carina, his servant.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Inspired by Star-Lord, she turns on her master and frees every being he keeps, leaving him at their mercy.
stages.whoA: The Collector, the master she turns on.
stages.whoB: Carina, the servant who frees his collection.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Nebula pretends to hand T'Challa and Yondu over to the Collector, but she is tricking him so the crew can take the Embers.
stages.whoA: The Collector, the mark she tricks.
stages.whoB: Nebula, a thief who tricks him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Fury knows Natasha is innocent when she is framed for Tony's death and secretly slips her the syringe. She hunts the killer for him and leaves him her last clue, hope, before she dies.
stages.whoA: Natasha, his agent, framed for murder.
stages.whoB: Fury, her director, who trusts her innocence.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hank blames Fury for luring his daughter Hope into S.H.I.E.L.D., where she died. He kills Fury's Avengers candidates one by one until Fury, with Loki's help, unmasks and stops him.
stages.whoA: Hank Pym, the killer of his Avengers candidates.
stages.whoB: Fury, the man he blames for Hope's death.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hank, as Yellowjacket, kills Natasha in a library as she closes in on him. She leaves Fury the clue that exposes him.
stages.whoA: Yellowjacket, the killer she hunts, who murders her.
stages.whoB: Natasha, an Avengers candidate he kills.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Loki comes to avenge Thor and threatens to freeze Earth, but Fury talks him into a deal. Loki helps Fury trap the killer by wearing his face.
stages.whoA: Loki, a vengeful prince who helps him catch the killer.
stages.whoB: Nick Fury, the director he bargains with.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Loki stays on Earth and declares himself its ruler. Fury fights back with a new team of heroes.
stages.whoA: Loki, now Earth's conqueror.
stages.whoB: Fury, who builds a team to fight him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hank killed Thor, and Loki takes Fury's place to lure him in. Loki overwhelms Yellowjacket with illusions and hands him to the Einherjar.
stages.whoA: Yellowjacket, Thor's killer, whom he catches.
stages.whoB: Loki, who traps him and takes him prisoner.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher places Natasha in this world, where Fury's new team is fighting Loki's rule. She steals his scepter and uses it to subdue him.
stages.whoA: Loki, the conqueror she subdues with his own scepter.
stages.whoB: A Natasha from another world who subdues him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: With her own world lost, Natasha lands in Fury's world as he fights Loki, and she joins his cause.
stages.whoA: Nick Fury, whose fight she joins in her new world.
stages.whoB: A Natasha from a dead world who joins his fight.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Christine is the love of Stephen's life, and her death in a car crash breaks him. He bends time again and again to save her, and when he finally does, his universe falls apart and she vanishes in his arms.
stages.whoA: Christine, the love he destroys a universe trying to save.
stages.whoB: Stephen, the man she loves, who breaks time for her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Strange gives his life to the Forge, and the universe he rebuilds lives again with Christine in it, but not him.
stages.whoA: Christine, alive again in the world he restores.
stages.whoB: Stephen, who dies to give her world back.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher refuses to save Strange's collapsing universe and keeps his oath. Later, fleeing Ultron, he turns to Strange for help, and together they gather the Guardians of the Multiverse.
stages.whoA: The Watcher, who refused to save his world, then sought his help.
stages.whoB: Strange Supreme, the sorcerer he turns to against Ultron.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: After giving his life to the Forge, Strange lives on as the soul of his restored universe. When the Eminence hunts the Watcher there, Strange strips him of his power.
stages.whoA: The Watcher, whom he saves from the Eminence.
stages.whoB: Strange, now the soul of his world, who saves him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Strange and Peggy fight side by side as Guardians of the Multiverse against Ultron. Afterward he stays behind to guard Killmonger and Zola.
stages.whoA: Captain Carter, a fellow Guardian against Ultron.
stages.whoB: Strange Supreme, the sorcerer of the Guardians.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Strange tricks Peggy into hunting Kahhori for him. When she learns he is feeding beings to the Forge she fights him, and as he falls into it, he holds back his demons to save his old friend.
stages.whoA: Peggy, an old friend he lies to, then saves as he falls.
stages.whoB: Strange, an old friend who lied to use her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Strange imprisons Kahhori to feed her power to the Forge and hunts her when she escapes. She and Peggy turn his prisoners against him and bring him down.
stages.whoA: Strange Supreme, who imprisons her for the Forge.
stages.whoB: Kahhori, an escaped prisoner he hunts.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Killmonger betrays the Guardians to claim Ultron's armor and Stones. Strange traps him and Zola in a pocket dimension and guards it, and later holds him as a prisoner for the Forge.
stages.whoA: Killmonger, the Guardian who betrays them, now his prisoner.
stages.whoB: Strange Supreme, who traps him in a pocket dimension.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Zola fights Killmonger for the Stones in Ultron's body. Strange seals them both away in a pocket dimension and keeps watch over it.
stages.whoA: Zola, his prisoner in a pocket dimension.
stages.whoB: Strange Supreme, his jailer.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Strange leads the Guardians' attack on Ultron, using his magic to undo the Stones' attacks again and again. Ultron turns on him and tries to kill him.
stages.whoA: Ultron, the AI threatening the multiverse.
stages.whoB: Strange Supreme, the sorcerer who blocks his attacks.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: When the Eminence chases the Watcher and Carter's team into his restored universe, Strange, its living soul, strips him of his power.
stages.whoA: The Eminence, a Watcher hunting his friends.
stages.whoB: Strange Supreme, who strips his power.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peter helps save Bruce in New York and travels with him to Camp Lehigh. Bruce passes him the Mind Stone, then turns into the Hulk to buy him time to escape.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, a fellow survivor he trusts with the Mind Stone.
stages.whoB: Bruce, who holds off Wanda so he can escape.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Years later, Bruce holds the Infinity Stones' power as the Infinity Hulk, and Peter comes to Paris to defend him against Wanda's horde.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who comes to defend him in Paris.
stages.whoB: The Infinity Hulk, the friend he fights to protect.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hope and her ant army save Bruce from the zombie Avengers, and she leads the survivors. Wounded on the train, she grows giant to carry them through the horde to Camp Lehigh and dies.
stages.whoA: The Wasp, who saves him and leads the survivors.
stages.whoB: Bruce, the man she saves in New York.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: At Camp Lehigh, the zombie Wanda tries to devour Bruce, and he turns into the Hulk to hold her off so his friends can escape.
stages.whoA: The zombie Wanda, whom he faces alone as the Hulk.
stages.whoB: Bruce, who holds her off as the Hulk.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Years later, Wanda throws her whole horde at the Infinity Hulk to take the Stones' power he holds, and she finally drains it from him.
stages.whoA: The Queen of the Dead, who drains his power.
stages.whoB: The Infinity Hulk, whose power she takes.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Vision takes Bruce's group into Camp Lehigh, until they learn he has been feeding survivors to Wanda. He helps them escape and tears out his Mind Stone, which Bruce takes from his body.
stages.whoA: Vision, an old teammate hiding a terrible secret.
stages.whoB: Bruce, a survivor he helps escape.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bruce comes back to New York to find his fellow Avengers turned into zombies. Iron Man, Doctor Strange and Wong turn on him until the Wasp saves him.
stages.whoA: His old teammates, now flesh eating zombies.
stages.whoB: Bruce Banner, a survivor they hunt.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hope and her ant army tear through the zombie Avengers to save Bruce.
stages.whoA: Earth's heroes turned zombies, whom she fights.
stages.whoB: The Wasp, a survivor who fights them.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Kamala's group joins the sorcerers to defend the Infinity Hulk in Paris. She tries and fails to stop Wanda from tapping his power.
stages.whoA: Kamala, who fights to protect him.
stages.whoB: The Infinity Hulk, whom she defends.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The zombie Thor joins Wanda's attack on the Infinity Hulk and kills his defenders. The Hulk destroys him with a blast.
stages.whoA: Thor, a zombified old teammate he destroys.
stages.whoB: The Infinity Hulk, who destroys him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Abomination charges the Infinity Hulk in the first wave of Wanda's horde, and the Hulk destroys him.
stages.whoA: Abomination, a zombie he destroys in Paris.
stages.whoB: The Infinity Hulk, who destroys him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: After Wakanda, the sorcerers of Kamar-Taj ask Bruce for help, and he takes the Infinity Stones' energy into himself to save the planet. When Wanda comes for that power, they lead the fight to defend him.
stages.whoA: The sorcerers who asked him to hold the Stones' power.
stages.whoB: Bruce, the Infinity Hulk they ask for help and defend.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peter and Scott, now a head in a jar, escape Camp Lehigh with T'Challa and fly the Mind Stone to Wakanda.
stages.whoA: Scott, the head in a jar he carries to Wakanda.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who carries him to Wakanda.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The sorcerers save them from Wakanda together, and they spend years at Kamar-Taj. They fight side by side in Paris, where the zombie Wasp comes for them both.
stages.whoA: Scott, his companion through the years at Kamar-Taj.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, his companion to the last fight.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Challa flies Peter and Scott out of Camp Lehigh and heads with them for Wakanda to cure the world.
stages.whoA: Black Panther, who flies him to Wakanda.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who carries the Mind Stone with him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: In Wakanda, they fight the zombie Thanos together, and T'Challa gives his life to destroy him.
stages.whoA: Black Panther, who dies stopping Thanos.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who fights Thanos beside him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Challa flies the Quadjet out of Camp Lehigh carrying Scott's head and Peter, breaking free of the zombie Wasp's grip.
stages.whoA: Black Panther, who flies him out of Camp Lehigh.
stages.whoB: Scott, a survivor he carries to Wakanda.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kurt survives the outbreak in Peter and Bruce's group and becomes Peter's friend. The zombie Wanda kills him at Camp Lehigh.
stages.whoA: Kurt, a friend among the survivors.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a friend among the survivors.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Vision shelters Peter's group at Camp Lehigh while hiding that he feeds survivors to Wanda. To atone, he tears out his Mind Stone, and Peter carries it away.
stages.whoA: Vision, who gives up his life and the Mind Stone.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who carries the Stone after he dies.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hope fights beside Peter as the survivors cross New York and ride the train to Camp Lehigh.
stages.whoA: The Wasp, who leads the survivors.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a fellow survivor.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Years later, the zombie Wasp fights in Wanda's horde in Paris and nearly eats Peter.
stages.whoA: The Wasp, now a zombie trying to eat him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, her prey in Paris.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Scott and Hope wait outside the Quantum Tunnel for her parents, but Hank comes back a zombie. Hope shrinks and escapes while Scott is bitten.
stages.whoA: Hope, the Wasp, who escapes when he is bitten.
stages.whoB: Scott, who is bitten as she escapes.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Years later, the zombie Wasp fights in Wanda's horde in Paris and attacks Scott and Peter.
stages.whoA: The Wasp, now a zombie who attacks him.
stages.whoB: Scott, her target in Paris.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kurt is Scott's friend and partner, and he makes it to Camp Lehigh, where Vision has cured Scott but saved only his head. The zombie Wanda kills Kurt there.
stages.whoA: Kurt, his friend and partner.
stages.whoB: Scott, his friend, now a head in a jar.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Vision uses the Mind Stone to cure Scott, though only his head survives. He keeps Scott at Camp Lehigh until the survivors arrive.
stages.whoA: Vision, who cured him and saved his head.
stages.whoB: Scott, the man he cured.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Vision carries the wounded T'Challa out of San Francisco, only to keep him at Camp Lehigh as food for Wanda.
stages.whoA: Vision, who keeps him as food for Wanda.
stages.whoB: T'Challa, a captive he keeps for Wanda.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Okoye is a general of the Dora Milaje and serves T'Challa as her king and close friend. She survives to reach Camp Lehigh, where he is found alive, but the zombie Wanda infects her there.
stages.whoA: Okoye, his general and close friend.
stages.whoB: T'Challa, her king.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bucky searches Camp Lehigh and finds his friend T'Challa badly hurt and hidden away by Vision.
stages.whoA: Bucky, a friend who finds him at Camp Lehigh.
stages.whoB: T'Challa, a friend he finds alive.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: In Wakanda, the zombie Thanos takes the Mind Stone and completes his Gauntlet. T'Challa pushes him into the vibranium core, killing them both.
stages.whoA: Thanos, the zombie he takes down with him.
stages.whoB: Black Panther, who drags him to his death.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Thor arrives with Rocket and Groot to help T'Challa, Peter and Scott fight Thanos in Wakanda.
stages.whoA: Thor, who comes to fight Thanos beside him.
stages.whoB: Black Panther, an ally in Wakanda.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Rocket and Groot join T'Challa's fight against the zombie Thanos in Wakanda, and Thanos kills them.
stages.whoA: Rocket and Groot, allies who die fighting Thanos.
stages.whoB: Black Panther, an ally in Wakanda.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Peter, T'Challa and Scott bring the Mind Stone to Wakanda and find the zombie Thanos waiting for it. Thanos tears it from them.
stages.whoA: Thanos, the zombie who takes the Mind Stone.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who carries the Stone he wants.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Rocket and Groot fight the zombie Thanos in Wakanda, and he kills them both.
stages.whoA: Thanos, the zombie who kills them.
stages.whoB: Rocket and Groot, two of his victims.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Rocket and Groot arrive in Wakanda with Thor to take on Thanos. Thor survives, badly hurt, and they do not.
stages.whoA: Thor, who arrives in Wakanda with them.
stages.whoB: Rocket and Groot, allies he loses to Thanos.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Thor fights the zombie Thanos in Wakanda. Thanos kills Rocket and Groot and leaves Thor badly burned and broken.
stages.whoA: Thanos, the zombie who breaks him.
stages.whoB: Thor, whom he leaves badly hurt.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Vision loves Wanda too much to end her after she turns. He hides her at Camp Lehigh and feeds her the survivors he lures in, until he gives up his Mind Stone to atone.
stages.whoA: Vision, her love, who feeds her the living.
stages.whoB: Wanda, the love he cannot let go.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Starved for days, the zombie Wanda wakes at Camp Lehigh and kills Kurt.
stages.whoA: Kurt, a survivor she kills.
stages.whoB: The zombie Wanda, who kills him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bucky stays behind to face the zombie Wanda at Camp Lehigh, and she hurls him far away.
stages.whoA: Bucky, who stands against her and is thrown aside.
stages.whoB: The zombie Wanda, who throws him aside.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: At Camp Lehigh, the zombie Wanda catches and infects Okoye.
stages.whoA: Okoye, a survivor she infects.
stages.whoB: Wanda, the zombie who infects her.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Years later, Okoye keeps her mind as a zombie and leads hordes for Wanda as her scion.
stages.whoA: Okoye, her scion and general.
stages.whoB: The Queen of the Dead, whom she serves.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peter escapes Camp Lehigh while the Hulk holds off the zombie Wanda.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who escapes her at Camp Lehigh.
stages.whoB: The zombie Wanda, whom he flees.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Years later, Peter comes to Paris with the sorcerers to fight Wanda's horde.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who fights her horde in Paris.
stages.whoB: The Queen of the Dead, whose horde he fights.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Okoye and Bucky stand guard together at Grand Central while the survivors start a train, and they kill the zombie Falcon.
stages.whoA: Bucky, her fellow guard among the survivors.
stages.whoB: Okoye, his fellow guard.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Steve was Bucky's best friend. Now a zombie, he attacks the survivors' train and infects Sharon, and Bucky cuts him in half.
stages.whoA: Steve, his best friend, now a zombie he must kill.
stages.whoB: Bucky, his best friend, who cuts him down.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The zombie Captain America ambushes the survivors' train and infects Sharon.
stages.whoA: Captain America, the zombie who infects her.
stages.whoB: Sharon, a survivor he infects.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Sharon travels with Hope and the other survivors. When the zombie Captain America infects her, Hope blows her apart and is wounded doing it.
stages.whoA: The Wasp, who kills her after she is infected.
stages.whoB: Sharon, a fellow survivor she must kill.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Wanda haunts Kamala's dreams, then poses as a healer at New Asgard to win her over. In Paris she breaks Kamala's spirit, uses her to remake the world, and traps her in an illusion.
stages.whoA: Kamala, the hero she wants and finally traps.
stages.whoB: The Queen of the Dead, who haunts and traps her.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Thor holds off Wanda in New Asgard so Kamala's group can escape, and she turns him into a zombie for her horde.
stages.whoA: Thor, whom she turns into her zombie.
stages.whoB: Wanda, who turns him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Valkyrie welcomes Wanda to New Asgard as an honored guest, until the food Wanda brings turns the Asgardians into zombies. Valkyrie attacks her and flees with Kamala's group.
stages.whoA: Valkyrie, who trusts her until the feast.
stages.whoB: Wanda, the guest who betrays New Asgard.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Alexei eats the feast Wanda brings to New Asgard and turns. In Paris she sends him against Kamala.
stages.whoA: Alexei, turned by her tainted feast.
stages.whoB: Wanda, whose feast turns him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The sorcerers of Kamar-Taj lead the stand against Wanda's horde in Paris, and all three fall.
stages.whoA: The sorcerers who defend the Hulk from her.
stages.whoB: Wanda, the Queen of the Dead they fight.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Blade warns that Wanda, the Queen of the Dead, is sending visions into Kamala's mind, and he fights her horde to the end in Paris.
stages.whoA: Blade Knight, who fights her horde.
stages.whoB: The Queen of the Dead, whom he fights.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Okoye leads Wanda's horde against the North Institute. When Melina stays behind to seize the zombies, Okoye takes them back and kills her with her spear.
stages.whoA: Melina, whom she kills at the North Institute.
stages.whoB: Okoye, the zombie general who kills her.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Okoye fights Valkyrie in the last battle in Paris and kills her.
stages.whoA: Valkyrie, whom she cuts down in Paris.
stages.whoB: Okoye, the zombie general who kills her.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Okoye hunts Kamala's group for Wanda. She storms the North Institute and wakes Namor to chase them at sea.
stages.whoA: Kamala, the hero she hunts for Wanda.
stages.whoB: Okoye, the zombie general hunting her.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Okoye wakes the zombie Namor and sends him after Kamala's group.
stages.whoA: Namor, the zombie king she sends on the hunt.
stages.whoB: Okoye, who sends him after the survivors.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The zombie Captain America crawls into the North Institute and attacks Alexei, who has been eager for the fight. Alexei kills him.
stages.whoA: Captain America, a zombie he kills.
stages.whoB: Red Guardian, who kills him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Kamala and Kate survive together in New York with Riri and set out for Ohio with the transmitter. Kate is killed on the road by the zombie Captain Marvel.
stages.whoA: Kate, her friend, killed on the road.
stages.whoB: Kamala, her friend and fellow survivor.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Riri survives with Kamala in New York and works out what the transmitter is. Bitten in battle, she sends F.R.I.D.A.Y. to fly Kamala to safety.
stages.whoA: Riri, her friend who saves her.
stages.whoB: Kamala, the friend she saves.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: In the world Wanda remakes, Riri breaks into the illusion to warn Kamala that none of it is real.
stages.whoA: Riri, warning her the new world is fake.
stages.whoB: Kamala, trapped in an illusion she tries to break.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Kate and Riri survive in New York with Kamala. Riri doubts the trip to Ohio, but Kate insists they try.
stages.whoA: Riri, her friend and fellow survivor.
stages.whoB: Kate, her friend, who pushes them to try.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. travels with Riri's group in an Iron Man armor. When Riri is bitten, F.R.I.D.A.Y. carries Kamala away, then comes back to fight beside her to the end.
stages.whoA: F.R.I.D.A.Y., her AI helper.
stages.whoB: Riri, whom she returns to fight beside.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. carries Kamala and the transmitter out of the battle against her wishes, then goes back for Riri.
stages.whoA: F.R.I.D.A.Y., who carries her to safety.
stages.whoB: Kamala, whom she carries to safety.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Blade Knight saves Kamala from Captain Marvel and Ikaris and helps her reach Ohio. He guides her group to New Asgard and dies in the last battle in Paris.
stages.whoA: Blade Knight, her protector and guide.
stages.whoB: Kamala, the hero he saves and guides.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Yelena helps defend the North Institute and joins Kamala's mission to reach space. On the Raft, she stays behind to launch their escape pod and dies.
stages.whoA: Yelena, a friend who dies so they can escape.
stages.whoB: Kamala, whose mission she joins.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Alexei joins Kamala's mission after the North Institute falls. Kamala talks him out of despair after Yelena dies, but in New Asgard he eats Wanda's tainted food and turns.
stages.whoA: Red Guardian, a friend she loses to Wanda's feast.
stages.whoB: Kamala, who gives him a reason to go on.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Kamala's group meets Shang-Chi on the Raft, and he joins them after Zemo betrays them. He tells her she gave them hope and fights beside her to the end.
stages.whoA: Shang-Chi, a friend who keeps her going.
stages.whoB: Kamala, the hero who gives his group hope.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Katy joins Kamala's group with Shang-Chi after the Raft falls and stands with her in the last battle.
stages.whoA: Katy, Shang-Chi's best friend, now hers too.
stages.whoB: Kamala, a new friend.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Zemo lets Kamala's group onto the Raft, then tries to sacrifice them to the zombie Namor. He escapes with them and is killed by zombies in New Asgard.
stages.whoA: Zemo, who tries to feed her group to Namor.
stages.whoB: Kamala, a hero he tries to sacrifice.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Namor storms the Raft and kills its people. Kamala distracts him with the transmitter and blows his head apart with her Noor.
stages.whoA: Namor, the zombie king she destroys.
stages.whoB: Kamala, who destroys him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Valkyrie lets Kamala's group into New Asgard and flies them into space after Wanda's betrayal. She falls in the last stand in Paris.
stages.whoA: Valkyrie, who takes her group in and flies them out.
stages.whoB: Kamala, a hero she takes in.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Kamala tries to reach the broken Thor in New Asgard. He holds off Wanda so her group can escape and tells her she is an Avenger now.
stages.whoA: Thor, the last Avenger, who calls her one too.
stages.whoB: Kamala, whom he names an Avenger.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The sorcerers save Kamala's group from the Nova Corps and bring them to Kamar-Taj, then lead them into the fight for the Infinity Hulk.
stages.whoA: The sorcerers who save her group.
stages.whoB: Kamala, a hero they save and fight beside.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Kamala meets Spider-Man, her idol, at Kamar-Taj, and they fight Wanda's horde together in Paris.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, her idol, met at last.
stages.whoB: Kamala, a fan who fights beside him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The zombie Captain Marvel, locked in battle with Ikaris, attacks Kamala's group and kills Kate. Kamala barely escapes.
stages.whoA: Captain Marvel, a zombie who kills her friend.
stages.whoB: Kamala, a survivor she attacks.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The zombie Captain Marvel kills Kate on the road to Ohio.
stages.whoA: Captain Marvel, the zombie who kills her.
stages.whoB: Kate, whom she kills.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Riri is caught in the zombie Captain Marvel's attack on her group, where she is bitten and stays behind to cover Kamala.
stages.whoA: Captain Marvel, a zombie whose attack costs her life.
stages.whoB: Riri, a survivor she attacks.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Ikaris is locked in an endless battle with the zombie Captain Marvel, and Kamala's group stumbles into it.
stages.whoA: Captain Marvel, the zombie he battles without end.
stages.whoB: Ikaris, the Eternal she fights.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Ghost chases the survivors out of the North Institute, and Blade cuts her to pieces.
stages.whoA: Ghost, a zombie he cuts down.
stages.whoB: Blade, who destroys her.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Valkyrie turns Kamala's group away from New Asgard until Blade reveals Khonshu, a friend of the Asgardians, and she lets them in.
stages.whoA: Valkyrie, who lets them in for Khonshu's sake.
stages.whoB: Blade Knight, Khonshu's avatar.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The zombie Thor kills Blade in the last battle in Paris.
stages.whoA: Thor, the zombie who kills him.
stages.whoB: Blade Knight, whom he kills.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Yelena guards the North Institute with her father, Alexei, and joins Kamala's mission when it falls. He comforts her over Melina's death.
stages.whoA: Her father, the Red Guardian.
stages.whoB: His daughter, Yelena.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Cut off on the Raft, Yelena tells Alexei to go and asks him to honor her with every breath. She dies, and he is left heartbroken.
stages.whoA: Her father, whom she asks to live on for her.
stages.whoB: His daughter, who dies saving them.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Melina guards the North Institute with Yelena and Alexei. She stays behind to hold off Okoye's horde, and Yelena is heartbroken to lose her.
stages.whoA: Melina, her mother figure, who dies holding the line.
stages.whoB: Yelena, the daughter who mourns her.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Alexei and Melina, once married as a cover, guard the North Institute together. He begs her not to stay behind against Okoye's horde, but she does and dies.
stages.whoA: Alexei, her former cover husband.
stages.whoB: Melina, his former cover wife, who dies for them.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Alexei nearly starts a fight when he spots Shang-Chi's infected arm at the Raft checkpoint. They become allies and escape the Raft together.
stages.whoA: Shang-Chi, mistaken for a zombie, then an ally.
stages.whoB: Red Guardian, who mistakes him for a zombie.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: When Zemo's escape pod will not launch, Yelena forces him to tell her how to override it. She runs to launch it and stays behind.
stages.whoA: Zemo, whom she forces to reveal the override.
stages.whoB: Yelena, who makes him talk.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: John Walker is Zemo's right hand on the Raft. When Namor breaks in, the two try to flee together, and Namor kills Walker.
stages.whoA: John Walker, his right hand.
stages.whoB: Zemo, his boss on the Raft.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Namor kills John Walker when he breaks into the Raft.
stages.whoA: John Walker, a victim on the Raft.
stages.whoB: Namor, the zombie who kills him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Katy is Shang-Chi's best friend. They flee San Francisco together, survive five years on the road, and wield the Ten Rings side by side in the last battle.
stages.whoA: Katy, his best friend.
stages.whoB: Shang-Chi, her best friend.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Shang-Chi is stunned to see his father arrive with the Ten Rings in San Francisco. When Shang-Chi is bitten, Wenwu uses his rings to hold back the infection and dies to the zombies.
stages.whoA: His father, who gives up the rings to save him.
stages.whoB: His son, whom he dies saving.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Jimmy Woo helps Shang-Chi and Katy escape San Francisco and survives with them for five years. Zombies kill him in New Asgard, and in Paris Shang-Chi must face him as one of Wanda's zombies.
stages.whoA: Jimmy Woo, a fellow survivor for five years.
stages.whoB: Shang-Chi, whose group he rides with.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Death Dealer flies Shang-Chi's group out of San Francisco and survives with them for years. He dies in New Asgard and returns as one of Wanda's zombies in Paris.
stages.whoA: Death Dealer, his father's warrior and a fellow survivor.
stages.whoB: Shang-Chi, his master's son.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Death Dealer is one of Wenwu's Ten Rings warriors. After Wenwu falls, he flies Wenwu's son to safety.
stages.whoA: Death Dealer, one of his warriors.
stages.whoB: Wenwu, his leader.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The sorcerers rescue Peter and Scott from the blast in Wakanda and shelter them at Kamar-Taj for years. They fight Wanda's horde together in Paris.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, a survivor they rescue.
stages.whoB: The sorcerers who rescue him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The sorcerers rescue Scott and Peter from the blast in Wakanda and shelter them at Kamar-Taj for years. They fight Wanda's horde together in Paris.
stages.whoA: Scott, a survivor they rescue.
stages.whoB: The sorcerers who rescue him.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: The zombie Thor joins Wanda's horde in Paris and kills Sara and the London Master.
stages.whoA: Thor, the zombie who kills two of them.
stages.whoB: The sorcerers he cuts down.

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Valkyrie rules New Asgard and shelters the broken Thor, who has lost his will to fight. When the zombies come for him, she tries to save him but has to leave him behind.
stages.whoA: Valkyrie, his friend, who shelters him.
stages.whoB: Thor, her old king, broken after Wakanda.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Jane tracks Thor to his party on Earth, and the two fall for each other. She reaches Frigga through Heimdall to end his party, and they plan a date before he goes home.
stages.whoA: Jane, the astrophysicist he falls for.
stages.whoB: Thor, the party prince she falls for.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Jane and Darcy track Thor's arrival together and follow him to his party. Darcy gives Jane the idea of calling Frigga through Heimdall.
stages.whoA: Darcy, her friend who joins the hunt for Thor.
stages.whoB: Jane, her friend.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Howard asks Darcy out at Thor's party, and they are married before morning.
stages.whoA: Darcy, the woman he marries at Thor's party.
stages.whoB: Howard, the duck she marries.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Darcy lays an egg, and the two chase it across the cosmos after it is stolen. It hatches into their daughter, Byrdie.
stages.whoA: His wife, the mother of their daughter.
stages.whoB: Her husband, Byrdie's father.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Howard is Byrdie's father. He and Darcy protect her egg from half the cosmos until she hatches, and they raise her on Earth.
stages.whoA: Her dad.
stages.whoB: His daughter.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Darcy is Byrdie's mother. She and Howard protect the egg from half the cosmos until Byrdie hatches, and they raise her on Earth.
stages.whoA: Her mom.
stages.whoB: Her daughter.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kaecilius takes Howard and Darcy's egg to make it a host for Dormammu. They steal it back in the Mirror Dimension, and he follows them to Jotunheim, where the hatching kills him.
stages.whoA: Howard, the father of the egg he wants.
stages.whoB: Kaecilius, the zealot who wants his child for Dormammu.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kaecilius takes Darcy and Howard's egg to make it a host for Dormammu. They steal it back in the Mirror Dimension, and he follows them to Jotunheim, where the hatching kills him.
stages.whoA: Darcy, the mother of the egg he wants.
stages.whoB: Kaecilius, the zealot who wants her child for Dormammu.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Yondu brings the stolen egg to Kaecilius and raises his price. Kaecilius takes the egg, and his Zealots kill Yondu.
stages.whoA: Yondu, the seller he has killed.
stages.whoB: Kaecilius, whose Zealots kill him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kaecilius plans to give Byrdie, still in her egg, to Dormammu as a host. When she hatches on Jotunheim, her blast of power kills him.
stages.whoA: Byrdie, the child he would give to Dormammu.
stages.whoB: Kaecilius, killed by the blast of her hatching.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Grandmaster invites Howard and Darcy aboard his cruise and offers to look after their egg, planning to serve it for brunch. He chases it all the way to Jotunheim and dies in the battle over it.
stages.whoA: Howard, a guest whose egg he wants to eat.
stages.whoB: The Grandmaster, who tries to eat his child.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Grandmaster invites Darcy and Howard aboard his cruise and offers to look after their egg, planning to serve it for brunch. He chases it all the way to Jotunheim and dies in the battle over it.
stages.whoA: Darcy, a guest whose egg he wants to eat.
stages.whoB: The Grandmaster, who tries to eat her child.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Yondu snatches the egg from the Grandmaster's brunch and escapes his cruise with it.
stages.whoA: Yondu, the Ravager who steals his egg.
stages.whoB: The Grandmaster, whom he robs.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Grandmaster plans to eat Byrdie while she is still an egg, and he grabs it again on Jotunheim before losing it.
stages.whoA: Byrdie, the egg he wants to eat.
stages.whoB: The Grandmaster, who wants to eat her egg.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Yondu steals Howard and Darcy's egg from the Grandmaster's cruise and escapes them through a jump point.
stages.whoA: Howard, whose egg he steals.
stages.whoB: Yondu, the Ravager who steals his egg.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Yondu steals Darcy and Howard's egg from the Grandmaster's cruise and escapes them through a jump point.
stages.whoA: Darcy, whose egg he steals.
stages.whoB: Yondu, the Ravager who steals her egg.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Yondu steals Byrdie's egg from the Grandmaster's cruise to sell it, and it costs him his life.
stages.whoA: Byrdie, the egg he steals to sell.
stages.whoB: Yondu, who steals her egg.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Killmonger saves Tony from a Ten Rings ambush and wins his trust. Tony gives him Stane's old job and helps him build vibranium drones.
stages.whoA: Tony Stark, whose trust he wins by saving him.
stages.whoB: Erik, the soldier who saved his life.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Tony learns Killmonger killed Rhodey and turns a drone on him. Killmonger kills Tony and erases the evidence.
stages.whoA: Tony, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: Killmonger, Rhodey's killer, who kills him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Challa is Killmonger's cousin, but they meet as enemies when T'Challa comes for Klaue. Killmonger kills him and frames Rhodey, and later T'Challa confronts him on the Ancestral Plane.
stages.whoA: His cousin, whom he kills to start a war.
stages.whoB: His cousin Killmonger, who murders him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Killmonger claims his place in Wakanda's royal family, and his cousin Shuri is wary of him from the start. She learns the truth and joins Pepper to expose him.
stages.whoA: His cousin Shuri, who sees through him.
stages.whoB: Her cousin, who killed her brother.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Pepper suspects Killmonger in Tony's and Rhodey's deaths and teams up with Shuri to expose him. They close in on him in Wakanda.
stages.whoA: Pepper Potts, who doubts him and hunts him down.
stages.whoB: Killmonger, the man who killed Tony.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Killmonger exposes Stane as the man who paid the Ten Rings to have Tony killed, and Stane is arrested.
stages.whoA: Stane, the traitor he exposes.
stages.whoB: Erik, the man who exposes him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Klaue's vibranium deal draws T'Challa into Killmonger's trap. Killmonger later has Klaue drive him to Wakanda's border and kills him there.
stages.whoA: Klaue, a tool he uses and then kills.
stages.whoB: Killmonger, who uses him and kills him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Pepper is Tony's partner, and she warns him against dealing with Klaue. After his death, she sets out to learn the truth.
stages.whoA: Pepper, his partner.
stages.whoB: Tony, her partner, whose death she looks into.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Obadiah Stane is Tony's partner at Stark Industries, until Killmonger exposes him for paying the Ten Rings to kill Tony.
stages.whoA: Stane, his partner who paid for his death.
stages.whoB: Tony, the partner he betrayed.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Challa is Shuri's brother. After his death, she uncovers Killmonger's lies and teams up with Pepper to expose him.
stages.whoA: His sister.
stages.whoB: Her brother, killed by Killmonger.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Challa, as Black Panther, boards Klaue's ship to take back Wakanda's stolen vibranium. It is a trap, and Killmonger kills him there.
stages.whoA: Klaue, the thief he hunts.
stages.whoB: Black Panther, who comes for him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Shuri finds Pepper in her office and confirms Killmonger's lies. The two join forces to expose him.
stages.whoA: Shuri, who joins her to expose Killmonger.
stages.whoB: Pepper, her partner against Killmonger.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher brings Killmonger into the Guardians of the Multiverse alongside Peggy to fight Ultron.
stages.whoA: Captain Carter, a fellow Guardian.
stages.whoB: Killmonger, a fellow Guardian.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Once Ultron falls, Killmonger betrays the team to take Ultron's armor and Stones. Later, as Strange's prisoner, he tries to stop Peggy and Kahhori at the Forge.
stages.whoA: Captain Carter, a Guardian he betrays.
stages.whoB: Killmonger, the Guardian who betrays them.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher plucks Killmonger out of Wakanda to fight Ultron, but Killmonger betrays the team to seize the Stones for himself.
stages.whoA: The Watcher, who recruits him and is betrayed.
stages.whoB: Killmonger, the recruit who betrays him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Killmonger seizes Ultron's armor and Stones, and Zola, now in Ultron's body, fights him for them. Strange traps them together.
stages.whoA: Zola, who fights him for the Stones.
stages.whoB: Killmonger, who fights him for the Stones.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Killmonger, wearing Ultron's armor, tries to stop Kahhori and Peggy from shutting down the Forge. Kahhori beats him and sends him home.
stages.whoA: Kahhori, who takes his armor and sends him home.
stages.whoB: Killmonger, a prisoner she beats.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Natasha and Clint are the last survivors of Ultron's war. They find Zola's mind together, and Clint gives his life to cover her escape.
stages.whoA: Clint, her best friend and last companion.
stages.whoB: Natasha, his best friend.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Natasha and Clint wake Zola's mind and force him to help them destroy Ultron. She later fires the Zola arrow into Ultron's eye, and Zola takes his body.
stages.whoA: Zola, the HYDRA mind she turns against Ultron.
stages.whoB: Natasha, who wakes him and uses him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Clint loads Zola's mind into an arrow and fires it into one of Ultron's drones.
stages.whoA: Zola, the mind he loads into an arrow.
stages.whoB: Hawkeye, who fires him into Ultron's drones.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ultron destroys Natasha's world and leaves her one of its last survivors. She ends him by firing Zola into his eye.
stages.whoA: Ultron, who wiped out her world.
stages.whoB: Natasha, the survivor who destroys him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Clint survives Ultron's war on humanity, which costs him his family, then dies destroying Ultron's drones to save Natasha.
stages.whoA: Ultron, whose war took his family and world.
stages.whoB: Hawkeye, one of the last humans.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Zola's code destroys Ultron from within, and Zola takes over his body.
stages.whoA: Zola, the code that destroys him.
stages.whoB: Ultron, whose body he takes.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ultron learns of the multiverse when he notices the Watcher, then hunts him across worlds and nearly kills him.
stages.whoA: The Watcher, whom he hunts across worlds.
stages.whoB: Ultron, who hunts him and threatens every world.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peggy fights Ultron with the Guardians and exposes his eye so Natasha can fire Zola into it.
stages.whoA: Captain Carter, who helps bring him down.
stages.whoB: Ultron, the threat to the multiverse she fights.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: When Thanos comes to Earth with five Stones, Ultron kills him and takes the Stones.
stages.whoA: Thanos, whom he kills for the Stones.
stages.whoB: Ultron, who kills him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Star-Lord steals the Soul Stone from Ultron in the Guardians' attack.
stages.whoA: Star-Lord, who steals his Soul Stone.
stages.whoB: Ultron, whom he robs in battle.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ultron bursts into Thor's world as his party ends. Thor later lures him into the Guardians' trap and fights him with Strange.
stages.whoA: Thor, a Guardian who lures him into a trap.
stages.whoB: Ultron, who invades his world.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Gamora fits her Infinity Crusher onto Ultron's Stones, but it fails outside her own universe.
stages.whoA: Gamora, who tries to destroy his Stones.
stages.whoB: Ultron, whose Stones she tries to crush.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher chooses Peggy to lead the fight against Ultron and brings her into the Guardians. Afterward, he talks her into living in her own present.
stages.whoA: Captain Carter, the hero he chooses.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, who recruits her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher comes to count Peggy as a friend and follows her story, though she pushes back when he will not help a dying world. After Strange's death, he takes her to see the multiverse.
stages.whoA: Peggy, the hero he calls a friend.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, a friend she argues with.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The other Watchers put him on trial for growing so close to her. Peggy is captured trying to save him and gives her life to carry everyone to safety.
stages.whoA: Peggy, who dies saving him.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, whom she dies saving.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher pulls Star-Lord from his fight with Ego to join the Guardians against Ultron, then sends him home.
stages.whoA: Star-Lord, a hero he recruits.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, who recruits him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher pulls Thor from his brawl with Ultron's drones in Las Vegas to join the Guardians, then sends him home.
stages.whoA: Thor, a hero he recruits.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, who recruits him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher recruits Gamora as she destroys the Infinity Gauntlet with Tony and Eitri, and she joins the Guardians against Ultron.
stages.whoA: Gamora, a hero he recruits.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, who recruits her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher watches Natasha survive Ultron's war. He cannot restore her world, so after the battle he places her in a new one where she can start over.
stages.whoA: Natasha, the survivor he gives a new world.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, who gives her a new home.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Natasha takes the Guardians for Ultron's agents until Peggy speaks of her friendship with her own Natasha. They fight Ultron together, and Peggy exposes his eye for Natasha's arrow.
stages.whoA: A Natasha from another world, fighting beside her.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, who wins her trust.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peggy and Star-Lord fight side by side as Guardians of the Multiverse against Ultron.
stages.whoA: Star-Lord, a fellow Guardian.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, a fellow Guardian.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peggy and Thor fight side by side as Guardians of the Multiverse, and Thor lures Ultron to them early.
stages.whoA: Thor, a fellow Guardian.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, a fellow Guardian.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peggy and Gamora fight side by side as Guardians of the Multiverse, and Peggy's team pins Ultron down for Gamora's Crusher.
stages.whoA: Gamora, a fellow Guardian.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, a fellow Guardian.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Thanos sends Gamora to kill Tony on Sakaar, but they are locked up together and he urges her to forge her own path. She kills Thanos with his help, and later they destroy the Infinity Gauntlet together on Nidavellir.
stages.whoA: Tony, the man she was sent to kill. Now her ally.
stages.whoB: Gamora, sent to kill him. Now on his side.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Grandmaster keeps the stranded Tony on Sakaar for his own fun. Tony beats him in a rigged race for the throne, and Valkyrie melts him into a puddle.
stages.whoA: The Grandmaster, the ruler he unseats.
stages.whoB: Tony Stark, the guest who beats him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Tony brings Valkyrie into his revolt against the Grandmaster. She takes out Topaz and is crowned ruler of Sakaar.
stages.whoA: Valkyrie, his ally in the revolt.
stages.whoB: Tony, who brings her into the revolt.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Tony saves Korg from a beast in the death race, and Korg joins his revolt.
stages.whoA: Korg, a racer he saves.
stages.whoB: Tony, who saves his life.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Topaz locks Tony up, and when he wins the race, the Grandmaster orders her to kill him.
stages.whoA: Topaz, the enforcer ordered to kill him.
stages.whoB: Tony, a prisoner she is told to kill.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Valkyrie crashes into Topaz to stop her killing Tony, and Topaz's staff melts the Grandmaster.
stages.whoA: Topaz, the enforcer she defeats.
stages.whoB: Valkyrie, who beats her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Valkyrie races in Tony's revolt, and her crash leaves the Grandmaster a puddle. The people crown her ruler of Sakaar in his place.
stages.whoA: The Grandmaster, the ruler she replaces.
stages.whoB: Valkyrie, who takes his throne.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Korg and Valkyrie join Tony's revolt together and celebrate when she is crowned.
stages.whoA: Korg, a fellow rebel.
stages.whoB: Valkyrie, a fellow rebel.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Topaz is the Grandmaster's chief enforcer. After he is melted, he begs her to gather up his puddle.
stages.whoA: Topaz, his chief enforcer.
stages.whoB: Her boss, the Grandmaster.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Korg races in the Grandmaster's death race, then turns against him in Tony's revolt.
stages.whoA: Korg, a racer who joins the revolt.
stages.whoB: The Grandmaster, the ruler he rebels against.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Topaz captures Gamora as she is about to kill Tony and locks the two of them up.
stages.whoA: Topaz, who imprisons her.
stages.whoB: Gamora, a prisoner she takes.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Irani Rael recruits Nebula into the Nova Corps, and later asks her to keep looking into Yondu's murder in secret.
stages.whoA: Nova Prime, the leader who recruits her.
stages.whoB: Nebula, a Nova Corps officer she recruits.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Rael has been using Nebula to break into the mainframe for Ronan. Nebula exposes her, and Rael falls to her death rather than take Nebula's hand.
stages.whoA: Rael, the leader who betrayed Xandar.
stages.whoB: Nebula, who exposes her plot.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Nebula brings her case to Howard, and he and his staff patch her up and help her storm Nova Corps headquarters. Howard congratulates her once Xandar is saved.
stages.whoA: Howard, the casino owner who helps her.
stages.whoB: Nebula, the officer he helps save Xandar.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Nebula frees Yon-Rogg from prison to help her reach the mainframe, but he betrays her and steals the code for Ronan. He turns on her again in the final fight, and Korg kills him.
stages.whoA: Yon-Rogg, the prisoner who betrays her twice.
stages.whoB: Nebula, who frees him and is betrayed.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ronan betrays and kills Thanos and Gamora, leaving Nebula stranded in space. Years later, she turns Xandar's shield on his ship, destroying it with him aboard.
stages.whoA: Ronan, who killed her family.
stages.whoB: Nebula, who destroys his ship.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Rael secretly agrees to let Ronan's forces into Xandar in exchange for staying in charge.
stages.whoA: Ronan, her secret partner.
stages.whoB: Rael, who sells him Xandar.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Yon-Rogg steals the shield code from Nebula's head for Ronan.
stages.whoA: Ronan, the warlord he serves.
stages.whoB: Yon-Rogg, an agent who steals the code.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Carter's team lands on Xandar and helps Nova Prime Nebula bring down a giant monster. Nebula distrusts them at first, then thanks them for saving her world.
stages.whoA: Nebula, Nova Prime of a world she helps save.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, whose team saves Xandar.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ego is Peter's father. He has Yondu deliver Peter to him, trains his powers, and sends him to prepare Earth for the Expansion.
stages.whoA: His father, who trains him to remake Earth.
stages.whoB: His son, the key to his Expansion.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: When Ego reveals he had Peter's mother killed, Peter turns on him and destroys his body with his own seed.
stages.whoA: His father, who killed his mother.
stages.whoB: His son, who destroys his body.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hope sees that Peter only wants to go home and frees him, giving him her Walkman. After the battle, the two are given a cat, Goose, to share.
stages.whoA: Hope, the girl who frees him.
stages.whoB: Peter, the lonely boy she sets free.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hank joins the team sent to stop Peter and fights him at Coney Island.
stages.whoA: Ant-Man, one of the heroes sent to stop him.
stages.whoB: Peter, the boy he must stop.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hank finds Peter and comforts him over his lost mother, and Peter turns on Ego.
stages.whoA: Hank, who comforts him and wins him over.
stages.whoB: Peter, a lonely boy he comforts.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Wendy goes with Hank to find Peter and bring him back to face Ego. Afterward, she gives him and Hope the cat Goose.
stages.whoA: Wendy Lawson, who helps bring him back.
stages.whoB: Peter, the boy she helps find.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peggy gathers a team to stop Peter's rampage. When Ego arrives, she holds him back until Peter turns on his father.
stages.whoA: Peggy Carter, whose team comes to stop him.
stages.whoB: Peter, the boy her team must stop.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Chaka fights Peter at Coney Island as Black Panther, then suggests pitting him against his father.
stages.whoA: Black Panther, who fights him.
stages.whoB: Peter, the boy he fights, then plays against Ego.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bill fights Peter at Coney Island as Goliath.
stages.whoA: Goliath, who fights him at Coney Island.
stages.whoB: Peter, the boy he fights.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hope is Hank's young daughter, and she comes along when he joins the team. She frees Peter with her father's Pym Particles.
stages.whoA: His daughter.
stages.whoB: Her dad.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bill Foster is Hank's former colleague, and they work together again on the 1988 team.
stages.whoA: Bill Foster, his old colleague.
stages.whoB: Hank Pym, his old colleague.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hank and Wendy go together to find Peter while the others hold back Ego.
stages.whoA: Wendy Lawson, his partner on the search.
stages.whoB: Hank, her partner on the search.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peggy's S.H.I.E.L.D. calls Hank back through Howard Stark. He refuses at first after losing his wife, then joins once he sees Peter in action.
stages.whoA: Hank Pym, a reluctant hero she brings back.
stages.whoB: Peggy Carter, who calls him back to S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ego lands outside the S.H.I.E.L.D. base to finish his Expansion, and Peggy's forces hold him back.
stages.whoA: Peggy Carter, who stands against him.
stages.whoB: Ego, the Celestial she holds back.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Chaka fights Ego as Black Panther to buy time for Peter to be found.
stages.whoA: Black Panther, who fights him.
stages.whoB: Ego, the Celestial he fights.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bill fights Ego as Goliath to buy time for Peter to be found.
stages.whoA: Goliath, who fights him.
stages.whoB: Ego, the Celestial he fights.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Darcy is Happy's intern at Avengers Tower, and he sends her on errands to keep her out of his way. When Hammer attacks, he turns to her for help, and she convinces the Avengers that the monster is Happy.
stages.whoA: Darcy, his intern, who saves the night with him.
stages.whoB: Happy, her boss at Avengers Tower.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hammer raids Avengers Tower on Christmas Eve for Hulk's blood, and Happy sets out to stop him alone. Mutated by the blood, Happy beats Hammer in his Hulkbuster armor.
stages.whoA: Justin Hammer, the intruder he stops.
stages.whoB: Happy, the security chief who beats him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hammer's men capture Darcy as she tries to reboot the Tower, and he holds her hostage to lure Happy.
stages.whoA: Justin Hammer, who takes her hostage.
stages.whoB: Darcy, a hostage he uses as bait.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Odin is Hela's father. He banishes her to Earth without her powers, then comes for the Ten Rings; she beats him, and he gives her the throne.
stages.whoA: Her father, who banished her.
stages.whoB: His daughter, who beats him and takes his throne.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Wenwu fights Hela when she falls to Earth, then pities her and offers an alliance, leaning in for a kiss before she knocks him out. She returns to fight beside him when Odin attacks, and later unites the Ten Rings with Asgard.
stages.whoA: Wenwu, the warlord who offers her an alliance.
stages.whoB: Hela, a fallen goddess he invites to his side.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Odin attacks the Ten Rings to take the rings for Asgard, and Wenwu fights him beside Hela.
stages.whoA: Odin, who comes for his rings.
stages.whoB: Wenwu, the warlord whose rings he wants.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Wáhta is Kahhori's brother. Conquistadors capture him, and she comes back from the Sky World with her new powers to free him.
stages.whoA: Her brother.
stages.whoB: His sister.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Gonzolo shoots Kahhori, and she falls into the lake to the Sky World. She returns with the Sky People, defeats his men, and kills him.
stages.whoA: Rodrigo Gonzolo, the conquistador who shoots her.
stages.whoB: Kahhori, who returns with power and defeats him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Gonzolo's soldiers capture Wáhta at the lake and put him in chains, until Kahhori frees him.
stages.whoA: Rodrigo Gonzolo, whose men capture him.
stages.whoB: Wáhta, a captive he takes.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Strange sends Peggy to capture Kahhori, but after a short fight Kahhori tells her the truth. Together they turn the prisoners against Strange and stop him.
stages.whoA: Captain Carter, sent to catch her, then an ally.
stages.whoB: Kahhori, the prisoner she is sent to catch.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kahhori joins Peggy's team of Guardians. After Peggy's sacrifice, Kahhori becomes a watcher of the multiverse.
stages.whoA: Peggy, her friend and team leader.
stages.whoB: Kahhori, her friend on the team.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kahhori helps rescue the Watcher from the Fifth Dimension. After Peggy's sacrifice, he invites her to watch over the multiverse with him.
stages.whoA: Kahhori, whom he invites to watch with him.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, whom she rescues and joins.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Storm helps rescue the Watcher from the Fifth Dimension. After Peggy's sacrifice, he invites her to watch over the multiverse with him.
stages.whoA: Storm, whom he invites to watch with him.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, whom she rescues and joins.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Byrdie helps rescue the Watcher from the Fifth Dimension. After Peggy's sacrifice, he invites her to watch over the multiverse with him.
stages.whoA: Byrdie, whom he invites to watch with him.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, whom she rescues and joins.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kahhori and Storm serve together on Peggy's team. When Peggy goes missing, they track her down with Byrdie and win Ultron's help.
stages.whoA: Storm, a teammate on Peggy's team.
stages.whoB: Kahhori, a teammate on Peggy's team.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kahhori and Byrdie serve together on Peggy's team and go after her together when she goes missing.
stages.whoA: Byrdie, a teammate on Peggy's team.
stages.whoB: Kahhori, a teammate on Peggy's team.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Storm and Byrdie serve together on Peggy's team, each trying to open the way to the Fifth Dimension to save the Watcher.
stages.whoA: Byrdie, a teammate on Peggy's team.
stages.whoB: Storm, a teammate on Peggy's team.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Storm wields Mjolnir on Peggy's team. Before the rescue, Peggy confides in her that she cannot bear to lose more friends.
stages.whoA: Storm, a friend she confides in.
stages.whoB: Peggy, her friend and team leader.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Byrdie joins Peggy's team and upgrades their Time Sphere to reach the Watcher.
stages.whoA: Byrdie, the team's young inventor.
stages.whoB: Peggy, her friend and team leader.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Long ago, the Eminence recruits Uatu, a young disciple, to become a full Watcher.
stages.whoA: Uatu, his protégé.
stages.whoB: The Eminence, who makes him a Watcher.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Eminence puts Uatu on trial for breaking his oath, captures him, and hunts Peggy's team. Strange strips his power, and Uatu talks him into learning by watching.
stages.whoA: Uatu, the Watcher he puts on trial.
stages.whoB: The Eminence, his judge and hunter.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Eminence captures Peggy when she goes after Ultron, and hunts her team as they flee. Her sacrifice carries them out of his reach.
stages.whoA: Captain Carter, the hero he captures and hunts.
stages.whoB: The Eminence, who captures her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ultron attacks the Eminence to free the Watcher and Peggy, and the Eminence kills him.
stages.whoA: Ultron, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: The Eminence, who kills him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Eminence tries to erase Kahhori with the rest of Peggy's team as they flee the Fifth Dimension.
stages.whoA: Kahhori, one of the Guardians he hunts.
stages.whoB: The Eminence, who hunts her team.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Eminence tries to erase Storm with the rest of Peggy's team as they flee the Fifth Dimension.
stages.whoA: Storm, one of the Guardians he hunts.
stages.whoB: The Eminence, who hunts her team.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Eminence tries to erase Byrdie with the rest of Peggy's team as they flee the Fifth Dimension.
stages.whoA: Byrdie, one of the Guardians he hunts.
stages.whoB: The Eminence, who hunts her team.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peggy seeks out this Ultron alone, unsure he can be trusted. He frees her and the Watcher from the Eminence and gives his life to cover their escape.
stages.whoA: Captain Carter, whom he dies saving.
stages.whoB: An Ultron who atones by saving her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ultron rescues the Watcher from the other Watchers, and the Watcher is stunned to find this Ultron on his side.
stages.whoA: The Watcher, whom he frees.
stages.whoB: An Ultron who rescues him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kahhori proposes asking an Ultron for help. This one, sorry for the lives he ended, carries her team to the Fifth Dimension.
stages.whoA: Kahhori, a Guardian he carries to the rescue.
stages.whoB: Ultron, the reformed AI who helps her team.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Storm and the Guardians confront Ultron, who spares them and carries them to the Fifth Dimension to save Peggy.
stages.whoA: Storm, a Guardian he carries to the rescue.
stages.whoB: Ultron, the reformed AI who helps her team.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Byrdie and the Guardians confront Ultron, who spares them and carries them to the Fifth Dimension to save Peggy.
stages.whoA: Byrdie, a Guardian he carries to the rescue.
stages.whoB: Ultron, the reformed AI who helps her team.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: King Thor blames Peggy for Hela's vanishing and orders her arrest. She and her allies steal the Time Stone from his scepter to save his world.
stages.whoA: King Thor, the tyrant who hunts her.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, the outsider he blames.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Wanda Merlin pulls Peggy into her world to save it and keeps believing in her, even when Thor blames her. She holds back the rift while Peggy works.
stages.whoA: Wanda Merlin, the sorceress who summons her.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, the hero she summons.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Sir Nicholas helps summon Peggy and later takes Thor's scepter for her plan.
stages.whoA: Sir Nicholas, a knight who helps her.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, the hero he helps.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Tony builds Peggy a device that uses the Time Stone to find the Forerunner and send him home.
stages.whoA: Tony, the inventor who builds her device.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, who brings him the problem.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Peggy meets Rogers, an outlaw who lost his own Peggy, and he helps her steal the Time Stone. He turns out to be the Forerunner, a Steve Rogers lost in time, and he goes home.
stages.whoA: Rogers, a Steve Rogers who is not her own.
stages.whoB: A Peggy who is not his own, but whom he helps.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Rogers and his outlaws rob the rich of King Thor's realm, and at court he fights the king's men. Once he is sent home as the Forerunner, Thor's world is restored.
stages.whoA: King Thor, the tyrant he robs and fights.
stages.whoB: Rogers, the outlaw who defies him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Wanda serves King Thor's court as its sorceress, and she holds him back when he turns on Peggy.
stages.whoA: King Thor, the king she serves.
stages.whoB: Wanda, his court sorceress.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Sir Nicholas is a knight of King Thor's court, and he takes the scepter from Thor in the fight at court.
stages.whoA: King Thor, the king he serves.
stages.whoB: Sir Nicholas, his knight.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Wanda and Sir Nicholas summon Peggy together to save their world.
stages.whoA: Sir Nicholas, who helps her summon Peggy.
stages.whoB: Wanda Merlin, who summons Peggy with him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Tony's device reveals Rogers as the Forerunner and sends him back to his own time.
stages.whoA: Rogers, the Forerunner his device sends home.
stages.whoB: Tony, whose device sends him home.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Sam befriends Bruce and brings him to his support group, but the Hulk nearly hurts Sam and his sister. Bruce's attempt to purge the Hulk creates the Apex, and Sam keeps his distance for years.
stages.whoA: Bruce, a friend whose cure goes terribly wrong.
stages.whoB: Sam, the friend who reached out to him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ten years later, Sam asks Bruce for help. Bruce becomes the Mega-Hulk to kill the Apex, and Sam talks him down as a friend.
stages.whoA: Bruce, the friend he talks down.
stages.whoB: Sam, the friend who never saw a monster.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Sam leads the surviving heroes in their mechs and links them with Bruce's protocol to form the Mighty Avenger against the Apex.
stages.whoA: The heroes he leads in giant mechs.
stages.whoB: Sam, their leader.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Sam leads the fight against the Apex and its gamma beasts, and gives the Mega-Hulk the opening to kill it.
stages.whoA: The Apex, the monster he fights.
