stages.whoB: Sam, who leads the fight against it.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bruce's attempt to purge the Hulk with gamma radiation creates the Apex. Ten years later, he becomes the Mega-Hulk and kills it, taking its place over the beasts.
stages.whoA: The Apex, the monster he created and kills.
stages.whoB: Bruce, its maker, who kills it.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Mech Avengers combine into the Mighty Avenger to fight the Apex, which beats them back with a gamma wave.
stages.whoA: The Apex, the monster they fight.
stages.whoB: The Mech Avengers, who fight it.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kingo comes to Hollywood to stop Agatha's plan, and she beats him in a duel on set.
stages.whoA: Agatha, the witch he came to stop.
stages.whoB: Kingo, the Eternal who tries to stop her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Agatha wins Kingo over with a three picture deal, and they drain Tiamut together. When she wants to rule the world, Kingo talks her into changing it through pictures with him instead.
stages.whoA: Agatha, his costar and partner in a new plan.
stages.whoB: Kingo, her costar who talks her down.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Alexei stops the Winter Soldier from killing the Starks and fights him, then the two go on the run to find the Rook. Alexei helps Bucky recover memories of who he was.
stages.whoA: The Winter Soldier, a rival who becomes his friend.
stages.whoB: Red Guardian, who helps him remember.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ordered to kill Alexei, Bucky kills Stane to protect him and buys him time to escape. Back in Siberia, he tells Dreykov that Alexei is dead.
stages.whoA: Bucky, the friend who saves him.
stages.whoB: Alexei, the friend he protects.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Alexei serves Dreykov and the Red Room, and resents that Dreykov trusts the Winter Soldier with the big missions.
stages.whoA: Dreykov, his master in the Red Room.
stages.whoB: Alexei, his agent.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Dreykov orders the Winter Soldier to kill Alexei, and Alexei learns the people he trusted betrayed him.
stages.whoA: Dreykov, who orders his death.
stages.whoB: Alexei, the agent he marks for death.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Dreykov orders the Winter Soldier to kill Alexei. Bucky returns claiming Alexei is dead, and Dreykov has his memories wiped again.
stages.whoA: Dreykov, who gives him his orders.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, his weapon.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bill hunts Alexei and Bucky across the West as Goliath, and Alexei knocks him down.
stages.whoA: Goliath, the agent hunting him.
stages.whoB: Red Guardian, a fugitive he hunts.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bill finds Alexei working as a gym teacher, returns his shield, and asks him to help the United States.
stages.whoA: Bill Foster, who offers him a new start.
stages.whoB: Alexei, the man he recruits.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bucky shoots at Bill during the chase, and later he and Alexei bring Goliath down in Las Vegas.
stages.whoA: Goliath, the agent chasing him.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, a fugitive he chases.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Alexei is thrilled to meet the Rook, until Stane reveals he is an American who used the Red Room to get rid of the Starks. Stane then tries to kill them.
stages.whoA: Stane, the Rook, who betrays all he believed.
stages.whoB: Alexei, an agent he tries to kill.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Bucky kills Stane when he turns on him and Alexei.
stages.whoA: Stane, the Rook, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: The Winter Soldier, who kills him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Wong, Okoye, Valkyrie and Ying Nan rescue Riri and recruit her to fight Beck. She later learns they died long before, a truth his illusions hid.
stages.whoA: The Alliance, the freedom fighters who recruit her.
stages.whoB: Riri, the inventor they recruit.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Beck rules a broken Earth with his drones, and Riri sets out to bring him down. He breaks her with the truth, but with the Watcher's help she drains his nanites and he dies.
stages.whoA: Quentin Beck, the tyrant she brings down.
stages.whoB: Riri, the rebel who kills him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Alliance fights Beck's Iron Federation and is driven to the brink. Its fighters die in the struggle, a truth Beck's illusions hide from Riri.
stages.whoA: Quentin Beck, the tyrant they resist.
stages.whoB: The Alliance, the rebels he crushes.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher breaks his oath again to speak to Riri as Beck is about to kill her, urging her to fight back.
stages.whoA: Riri, the hero he steps in to save.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, who urges her to fight back.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Shang-Chi searches the West for his sister Xialing, only to find she has become the Hood. He refuses to fight her and tells her he loves her, and Kate kills her before she can strike.
stages.whoA: His sister, lost to the Hood's power.
stages.whoB: Her brother, who will not fight her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Shang-Chi and Kate hunt the Hood together and become frontier legends. Kate kills Xialing to save him, and he forgives her and rides off with her for another adventure.
stages.whoA: Kate, his partner on the trail.
stages.whoB: Shang-Chi, her partner on the trail.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Kate hunts the Hood, whom she blames for her family's death. When Xialing moves to kill Shang-Chi, Kate shoots her.
stages.whoA: The Hood, the outlaw she hunts and kills.
stages.whoB: Kate Bishop, the archer who kills her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Burch hypnotizes Kate and boasts that he killed her parents. Freed by the bell, she beats him and leaves him to live with his crimes.
stages.whoA: Sonny Burch, the man who killed her parents.
stages.whoB: Kate, whose parents he killed.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Sonny Burch is the Hood's enforcer, running the ghost train and keeping the captured workers in a trance.
stages.whoA: The Hood, the boss he serves.
stages.whoB: Sonny Burch, her enforcer.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Burch captures Shang-Chi on the ghost train and brings him to meet the Hood.
stages.whoA: Shang-Chi, the hero he takes to the Hood.
stages.whoB: Sonny Burch, the Hood's enforcer.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Burch orders his men to find and kill Jun-Fan on the train.
stages.whoA: Kwai Jun-Fan, the boy he orders killed.
stages.whoB: Sonny Burch, who wants him dead.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Hood's gang ruins Jun-Fan's town and takes his father. His ringing of the train's bell frees the Hood's captives.
stages.whoA: The Hood, who took his father.
stages.whoB: Kwai Jun-Fan, the boy who frees her captives.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Jun-Fan begs Shang-Chi to save his father and leads him to the ghost train. Shang-Chi sees a future hero in him.
stages.whoA: Shang-Chi, the hero who comes to save his father.
stages.whoB: Kwai Jun-Fan, a brave boy who might be a hero.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Jun-Fan rides with Kate and Shang-Chi to the ghost train, and his bell breaks Burch's hold on her.
stages.whoA: Kate, a hero he rides with.
stages.whoB: Kwai Jun-Fan, the boy whose bell frees her.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: The Watcher steps in to save Jun-Fan when Burch's men try to throw him off the train.
stages.whoA: Kwai Jun-Fan, the boy he saves.
stages.whoB: The Watcher, who saves him unseen.
